personalInfo.name: Lakshya Jain
personalInfo.title: Backend & Distributed Systems Engineer
personalInfo.summary: CS undergrad at IIT Jodhpur building scalable backend, distributed and AI-powered systems — from a quant research platform on AWS and a censorship-resilient social network to a lightweight container orchestrator.

experience.title: Quant Developer Intern
achievements: Built an end-to-end quant research platform consolidating data, backtesting and workbench across 25 modules (64 data models) with auth/ACL, credits, RunBT orchestration and S3 workspaces; sole owner from architecture (14 ADRs) to production.

Engineered multi-tenant isolated runtimes on AWS ECS with STS-scoped S3 access and idle-reclaim (74% sessions auto-reclaimed, p50 start ~21s); load-tested to 600+ concurrent users at p95 38ms with zero errors and a projected 27% AWS cost reduction.

Established engineering rigor with C4-style architecture docs (~91 active docs) and a KPI pipeline tracking runtime, security and test metrics (65.1% test coverage, 76/100 auth security score, ~11ms avg API p95); layered JWT auth, central canAccess/requireRole ACL and dual-OS-user isolation.

experience.title: Founder & Lead Engineer
achievements: Founded and architected libr, a censorship-resilient decentralized social network launched into a week-long public beta; attracted 250+ landing page visitors, 570+ page views, 100+ downloads and 1,000+ user posts.

Designed a 3-tier system of clients, database nodes and moderators; built core services in Go with Docker, PostgreSQL, Kademlia DHT for content routing and cryptographic certificates for tamper-evident storage.
Implemented replicated DHT-based storage with partial immutability and O(log n) lookup, and a quorum-backed moderation layer backed by risk analysis covering 20+ identified risks.

experience.title: Domain Lead - Adobe Problem Statement
achievements: Led a cross-functional team building an AI-powered Flutter image editing app with on-device YOLO segmentation for real-time object masking and edge inference under a 200 MB device footprint.
Developed isolated Docker AI compute containers on edge servers, orchestrating parallel editing pipelines (inpaint, erase, move, compositing) with sub-30s end-to-end latency.
Directed integration of a multi-model AI pipeline - DDIM-based latent move, YOLO-guided Flux inpainting, U-Net attention-based erase and Qwen2.5-3B/Flux-Kontext compositing. Ranked 6th among 23 IITs.

experience.title: SDE Intern - Android Development
achievements: Engineered Pinnzo, a Flutter-based Android app for organizing and summarizing reading material for working professionals, deployed to the Google Play Store with Firebase real-time sync.
Partnered with startup founders to shape product features, reducing production time by 30% with Agile methodology and 2-week sprints.

Instrumented Google Analytics and Crashlytics to triage 163 critical bugs across Android versions, cutting crash rates by 40% and improving load speed by 25%, reaching 120+ beta users in the first month.

projects.title: Mini-K8ts - Container Orchestrator
projects.description: Lightweight container orchestrator for edge environments: <50 MB control-plane RAM, 25 MB binary, <1s startup, PostgreSQL as ACID state store. Reliability-aware multi-stage scheduler sustains 220+ tasks/sec (97.8-100% efficiency, 1000 tasks in 4.2s). Hardened with token RBAC, rate limiting, optional mTLS, Postgres-backed leader election and a 50-node/1,000-task scale-test suite with Prometheus/Grafana.

projects.title: FileNest - Multi-Modal P2P Search Engine
projects.description: Hierarchical distributed tagging system combining semantic embeddings with Kademlia DHT P2P routing for multi-modal search across text, PDFs, images and video. BERT, Sentence-Transformers and CLIP pipeline targeting 15-20 files/sec indexing and sub-100ms queries; CI/CD and modular monorepo built during Summer RAID 2025 at IIT Jodhpur.

projects.title: LIBR - Censorship-Resilient Digital Forum
projects.description: Decentralized forum with quorum moderation and content filtering; Byzantine fault tolerance evaluated across 10+ nodes. Multithreaded Go architecture with Kademlia DHT logic and cryptographic certificates, later grown into the libr social network.

projects.title: Adobe Inter-IIT - AI Image Editor
projects.description: AI-powered Flutter image editing app for Inter IIT Tech Meet 14.0 (ranked 6th of 23 IITs): on-device YOLO segmentation, Dockerized edge AI pipelines for inpaint/erase/move/compositing with sub-30s latency under a 200 MB footprint.

projects.title: GitCury - AI-Powered Git Automation CLI
projects.description: Git workflow automation that cut commit time from 17 minutes to 32 seconds (97% faster) across 298 files in a 4 MB footprint. Semantic file clustering reduces API calls by 90% (3.2x faster); 3 clustering strategies, concurrent worker pool, shipped via Homebrew, Scoop, Docker and 6 OS/arch binaries.

projects.title: 2nd Swap - Secure, Intelligent Second-Hand Trading
projects.description: Backend for a second-hand trading startup built and deployed in 1.5 weeks: 12+ REST endpoints at 99.8% uptime, an AI verification system generating item-specific questions (20% less manual review, 30+ daily queries) and OCR-based code recognition for item verification.

projects.title: NIDS - Network Intrusion Detection System
projects.description: Open-source network intrusion detection system: FastAPI backend captures live traffic via Scapy and classifies packets in real time using a custom Random Forest (bootstrapped feature sampling, information-gain trees) over 14 engineered features. Includes a Showcase NIDS web app.

projects.title: C3P - Collaborative Content Platform
projects.description: Full-stack platform for collaborative content creation with 8 user roles and one-click publishing to 4 social platforms (65% faster publishing); RBAC and engagement-based ranking on 6 metrics (+22% retention); automated publishing and revenue-sharing that processed $1200+ with 0 payment errors.

projects.title: RealmWeaver - Dynamic Game Environment
projects.description: Dynamic game world with AI-driven real-time generation of NPCs, quests and locations via the Gemini API. Round-robin API keys cut content generation from 5 min to under 1 min, and a centralized content system reduced manual world-building by 100x.

projects.title: GenCLI - Semantic File Retrieval Tool
projects.description: AI-powered CLI for intelligent file indexing and semantic search with Gemini. Indexing sped up from 19.2s to 1.2s per file via batching and parallelization, sub-second search across 50+ files and 7+ terminal themes.

projects.title: The Vindication - Text-Based Adventure Game
projects.description: Open-world text adventure in C with 27 quests, 7 mini-games, 120+ ASCII graphics elements, 15 audio tracks and JSON-driven content with unlimited save states and 100% data integrity.

projects.title: Image Filtration Program
projects.description: 6 image filters (Grayscale, Blur, Sharpen, Sobel Edge Detection, Reflect, Negative) for 24-bit BMP files up to 4K in under 3s, with 100% format compatibility and 15+ edge cases handled (96% fewer failures).

projects.title: Travel Companion App - Your Adventure, Simplified
projects.description: Campus mobile app with 360+ registered users and a 5-star rating: 7 core features (trip sharing, filtering, search) and a real-time Firebase request system with sub-1s responses for 10+ concurrent users.

projects.title: Summer Project - Version Control for Content Creators
projects.description: Summer 2024 project exploring version control for content creators; precursor to the collaborative content ideas behind C3P.

Open-source and document Mini-K8ts and libr for wider visibility
Pursue AWS/Kubernetes certifications to formalise cloud expertise
Keep mentoring through Devlup Labs and technical talks

summary.strengths_analysis: Deep Go and distributed-systems skills backed by shipped systems: a sole-owned 25-module quant platform on AWS, a P2P search engine, a container orchestrator and a decentralized social network, supported by measurable performance results.
